# `file_rename`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Rename an image file together with its accessory files.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xf6760, separateSuffix @0xf6270, AddAccessory @0x6ebad0 (64-bit build) |

Renames the main file, then finds its accessory files and renames them by regular-expression replacement of the source stem with the destination stem (unescaped, so regex metacharacters in names behave as regex). A failure partway through leaves earlier renames in place (no rollback). An existing destination is not explicitly rejected, so the underlying rename may replace it (INFERRED from the libc call). After the primary rename the handler checks the old source path for being a directory, which probably sees a non-existent path (INFERRED), with possible consequences for directory-type accessories. Regular-expression exceptions are not converted to error replies in this handler. Synchronous, no timeout.

Side effects: Renames the main image file and matching accessory files on the device filesystem; partial results are possible.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"file_rename"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object\|array | yes | - | Source and destination names. Object form or positional [src, dst]; extra keys and elements are ignored. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 105 | params missing, wrong container, or src/dst missing or not strings | `expected string param` |
| 255 | Source file not accessible | `file not exist` |
| 300 | Source and destination suffixes both non-empty and different | `internal error` |
| 515 | The primary or an accessory rename call failed | `rename failed` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

Exact handling of exceptions raised inside the regex replacement by the outer server is unresolved.

## Example

Request, rename - Invented names:

```json
{"id":53,"method":"file_rename","params":{"src":"Example_old.fit","dst":"Example_new"}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"file_rename","result":0,"code":0,"id":53}
```

Reply, error:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"file_rename","error":"file not exist","code":255,"id":54}
```
